title: Detach follow for tiny upward scrolls before persisting the viewport
outcome: Land the confirmed direction-sensitive fix for tiny upward movement retaining FOLLOW, separately from the unresolved session-dependent delayed jump.
acceptance: An upward scroll input that moves the transcript by 0.5–4 px detaches follow before the scroll write, and the detached position persists across a session switch and across new output arriving while the session is inactive. A focused regression shows each.
A downward scroll input that arrives at the physical bottom still reattaches follow. A test shows it.
The full gate passes on the exact committed tree.
